templates.name: Quarterly plan
templates.line: One chart per section, a summary at the end.
templates.prompt: Create a 10-slide deck for our Q3 growth plan: three goals (Expand retention, Launch new markets, Improve activation) and one chart per section.

templates.prompt: Create an 8-slide launch deck for Nova, a smart home speaker: a bold title slide, three feature slides and a pricing slide.

templates.name: Training course
templates.line: Steps in order, one idea per slide.

templates.name: Investor pitch
templates.line: The numbers first: traction, market, ask.

templates.name: Team update
templates.line: Status in three columns: on track, needs review, blocked.

templates.name: Case study
templates.line: A customer story with one strong quote.
templates.prompt: Create a 6-slide case study of how Nova helped a customer: a portrait, one strong quote and the result, +38% sales.

templates.name: Roadmap
templates.line: Four quarters on a single timeline.
templates.prompt: Create a 6-slide product roadmap with four quarters on one timeline: Plan, Build, Launch, Grow.

templates.name: Pricing
templates.line: Three plans side by side, one highlighted.
templates.prompt: Create a 4-slide pricing section with three plans: Starter $12, Pro $29 and Team $59, the middle plan highlighted.

templates.name: Year in review
templates.line: Four big numbers, a photo strip and a thank-you.
templates.prompt: Create an 8-slide year in review with four key numbers (12 launches, 48 markets, 72K users, 94% retention) and a photo strip.

templates.name: Quarterly report
templates.line: Two columns, a chart and a pull quote.
templates.prompt: Write a 4-page quarterly report titled 'Quarterly report' with a monthly revenue bar chart, two text columns and a pull quote.

templates.name: Project brief
templates.line: Goal, scope and timeline on one page.
templates.prompt: Write a one-page project brief titled 'Project brief' with the sections Goals, Scope and Timeline, three bullets each.

templates.name: Meeting notes
templates.line: Decisions, action items and owners.
templates.prompt: Write one page of meeting notes titled 'Meeting notes', dated 13 March 2025, with the attendees and the action items with an owner each.

templates.name: Cover letter
templates.line: A clean letter with your address and signature.
templates.prompt: Write a one-page cover letter to Ms Rivera for a product manager role, with my address at the top right and my signature.

templates.name: Resume
templates.line: A sidebar for skills, a column for experience.
templates.prompt: Write a one-page resume for Alex Moreau, product designer, with a photo, a skills sidebar and a column of experience.

templates.name: Proposal
templates.line: A cover block, scope and a price box.
templates.prompt: Write a 6-page proposal titled 'Website redesign proposal' with a cover, the scope and a price box.

templates.name: Newsletter
templates.line: A masthead, a hero picture, three columns.
templates.prompt: Write a 2-page newsletter called 'The Weekly' with a hero picture and three short articles headed News, Team and Events.

templates.name: Service agreement
templates.line: Numbered clauses and two signature lines.
templates.prompt: Write a 3-page service agreement with numbered clauses and two signature lines.

templates.name: Press release
templates.line: A headline, a quote and a contact block.
templates.prompt: Write a one-page press release headed 'For immediate release' with a headline, a quote and a contact block.

templates.name: Monthly summary
templates.line: Totals per month, with a chart.
templates.prompt: Build a monthly summary sheet, January to June, with revenue, expenses and profit per month, a total row and a column chart.

templates.name: Budget tracker
templates.line: Planned against actual, with the gap in colour.
templates.prompt: Build a budget tracker with the categories Housing, Food, Transport, Utilities and Savings, planned against actual, and a progress bar for each.

templates.name: Invoice list
templates.line: Who owes what, with a status on every line.

templates.name: Stock levels

templates.prompt: Build a stock sheet with the product, SKU, quantity and reorder level, and highlight the products that are low.

templates.name: Project plan

templates.prompt: Build a project plan with tasks and owners and a bar for each task across the weeks W1 to W8.

templates.name: Sales by region

templates.prompt: Build a sales-by-region sheet with North, South, East and West by quarter, colour-scaled like a heat map.

templates.name: Expense report
templates.line: Receipts by date, sorted by category, summed at the bottom.
templates.prompt: Build an expense report with the date, category, amount and receipt for each line, and the total at the bottom.

templates.name: Attendance tracker
templates.line: Names down the side, days across, one tick each.
templates.prompt: Build an attendance tracker with the names down the side, the days across, a tick for present and A for absent.

templates.name: Timesheet
templates.line: Hours per person, per day, with weekly totals.
templates.prompt: Build a weekly timesheet with the names, the hours from Monday to Friday and a total column.

templates.name: Business overview

templates.name: Sales pipeline

templates.prompt: Build a sales pipeline dashboard with the stages Lead, Qualified, Proposal and Won as columns of deal cards with amounts.

templates.name: Marketing

templates.name: Team workload

templates.name: Website analytics
templates.line: Visitors against last period and the top pages.

templates.name: Operations

templates.prompt: Build an operations dashboard on a dark theme: uptime tiles at 99.9%, a latency chart and an incident list.

templates.name: People and hiring

templates.prompt: Build a people dashboard: a headcount of 128, hiring progress rings by team and a team donut.

templates.line: A clear flat diagram a class can talk through.

templates.name: Product ad
templates.line: A brand, a bottle and a tagline: your product photo becomes a 15-second launch film.
templates.prompt: Make a 15-second product ad from my product photo. If I have no brand yet, invent one with me. Ask me for the photo, the product name and a tagline, show me the first frame, then add the brand text, music and a one-line voice-over.

image.alt: An emerald glass bottle rising out of fog on wet slate, the brand name Alderine in white capitals over it.

templates.name: Virtual try-on
templates.line: One person, one wardrobe: the colour and the garment change in a single film.
templates.prompt: Make a 20-second virtual try-on video. Ask me for a photo of the person, the garment and the colours or other garments I want to compare. Show me the still first, then animate the colour and garment changes in one video, with the name of each look on screen.

image.alt: A woman with a dark bob turning in a studio while her long coat changes from camel to emerald and then to black.

templates.name: Photo in a theme
templates.line: Your photo in a 90s, manga or space-opera look, then animated.
templates.prompt: Turn my photo into a 5-second video in a theme I choose (the 90s, manga, space opera...). Ask me for the photo and the theme, show me the restyled still, then animate it.

image.alt: A young man in a denim jacket in front of a neon-lit 90s arcade at night.

templates.name: Property film
templates.line: One continuous flight from the road to the terrace, with the price on screen.
templates.prompt: Make a 20-second immersive property film from my listing photos. Ask me for the best exterior photo, the address, the price and the three features to show. Fly in from the road, go through the front door to the terrace, and end on the price, with music and captions. Show me the first frame before you animate.

image.alt: A modern white villa with an infinity pool above a turquoise bay at golden hour, seen from the air.

templates.name: Social clip
templates.line: An idea becomes a vertical story with a voice-over, music and captions.
templates.prompt: Make a 15-second vertical clip for social media from my idea. Ask me for the idea and the mood, write a three-line script in English and show it to me, show me the first frame, then make the clip with the voice-over, music and captions.

image.alt: Flour-dusted hands kneading dough in warm window light, with the caption: Flour, water, and a little patience.

templates.name: Logo reveal
templates.line: Your logo animated in five seconds, with its sound.
templates.prompt: Animate my logo as a 5-second reveal. Ask me for the logo image and my brand colours.

image.alt: An amber ring and dot above the word LUMO and a tagline, on a dark navy background.

templates.name: Old photo, alive
templates.line: A worn print is restored in sharp HD, then its people move and speak.
templates.meta: 8 seconds · 16:9 · restored in HD, with a voice
templates.prompt: Bring my old photograph to life as a short film. Restore it in sharp high definition first and show me the restored picture next to the original; then animate it, with the people really moving (not just the face) and a voice line in my own language. Ask me for the photo, the place and the year and the story to tell; show me the lines before you animate.

image.alt: An old sepia family picnic by a lake, restored sharp: grandparents on a blanket, two children and their father standing, a dog in the grass.

templates.name: Workout with anatomy
templates.line: Three exercises, and the muscles each one works lit up like an anatomy chart.
templates.prompt: Make a 15-second workout video with three exercises that shows the muscles each one works, lit up like an anatomy chart. Ask me for the three exercises and the person (or use an invented athlete), show me the first frame of each, then add the exercise names, the muscle labels, a voice-over and music.

image.alt: An athlete mid pull-up with her muscles glowing red like an anatomy chart.

templates.name: Voicemail greeting, your voice
templates.line: Send a short recording of yourself: the greeting is read in your own voice.
templates.prompt: Make a voicemail greeting for my workshop in MY OWN voice. I will send you a short recording of myself: ask for my consent to clone it, and delete the reference after the call. Then read, in French: « Bonjour, et bienvenue à l'atelier. Nous ne pouvons pas répondre pour le moment. Laissez votre nom et votre numéro, et nous vous rappelons avant midi demain. » Give me the audio and a video with the captions.

image.alt: A waveform scrolling over a night-blue background while a French voicemail greeting plays, with its captions

templates.name: Physics explainer, your voice
templates.line: A 20-second lesson read in your own voice, over a picture for each idea.
templates.prompt: Make a 20-second explainer about why time runs slower the faster you move, read in MY OWN voice (I will send a short recording, ask for my consent before you clone it, and delete the reference after the call). One picture for each idea, soft piano music, captions. Use plain words and keep the physics right.

image.alt: A golden pocket watch melting in deep space, with the caption "time has to bend"

templates.name: Guided breathing

image.alt: A scrolling waveform on a deep teal background while a calm voice guides a breathing exercise, with its captions

templates.name: Bedtime story
